name: AI BnB
tagline: A travel chatbot that finds stays and plans trips, and generates listings from property photos for hosts.

awards: Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs

problem: Trip planning and listing creation are tedious for travellers and hosts.
solution: A chatbot plans trips and sources stays; hosts upload photos to generate listings.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a trip and get matching stays; upload photos and get a listing.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs” among 195 submissions.
Serves both sides of the rental market.
